title: Magnetic Phone Case with Stand – iPhone 12–17
descriptionHtml:
A new case every time you drop your phone? Expensive.

Cracked corners, a scratched lens and a stand that's never around when you want to watch a video. Sound familiar?

The solution: protection, stand and magnet – in one

A shockproof case with a raised edge that protects the screen and camera, a magnetic mount that snaps onto chargers and holders, and a built-in stand for video and calls.

Features

  • Screen and camera protected – raised edge
  • Snaps onto chargers and holders – magnetic mount
  • Watch hands-free – built-in stand for video and calls
  • Fits iPhone 12–17 incl. Pro Max, Air and 16e
  • Free from fingerprints – matte, scratch-resistant surface

Change of mind

You have 14 days to change your mind, counted from the day you receive the item.
